one_liner_zh: 網飛EPS低於預期6.9%，但營收年增逾16%顯示用戶與廣告變現動能仍強。
one_liner_en: Netflix missed EPS by 6.9%, yet 16%+ revenue growth shows membership and ad-monetization momentum stays strong.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期 / EPS低於預期6.93%，惟營收年增16.19%成長動能不弱。
ai_view_zh: 訊號好壞參半：EPS未達標可能反映內容或行銷投入加大，但營收年增逾16%證明變現動能（漲價＋廣告）仍強。短期股價對EPS miss可能短線承壓，惟營收成長是核心支撑。中期關鍵在廣告業務放量、利潤率擴張與用戶留存。追蹤指標：營收成長與廣告營收占比、營業利潤率、自由現金流、地區用戶趨勢與內容投資報酬。
ai_view_en: Signal is mixed: the EPS miss may reflect heavier content or marketing spend, but 16%+ revenue growth confirms monetization momentum (price hikes plus ads) remains strong. Near-term the stock may dip on the miss, though revenue growth is the core support. Mid-term the key is ad-business scaling, margin expansion and retention. Track: revenue growth and ad-revenue mix, operating margin, free cash flow, regional membership trends and content ROI.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.23美元，低於預期1.32美元，差距6.93%
營收122.5億美元，年增16.19%，用戶成長與漲價貢獻明顯
廣告方案與打擊帳號共享持續擴大營收基礎
內容投資與全球擴張支撑長期用戶黏著度
highlights_en: EPS of $1.23 missed the $1.32 estimate by 6.93%
Revenue of $12.25B grew 16.19%, with membership growth and price increases contributing
The ad tier and paid-sharing crackdown keep expanding the revenue base
Content investment and global expansion support long-term engagement
risks_zh: EPS未達標反映內容或行銷成本上升，利潤率須留意
26倍本益比下任何成長放緩都易引發回調
串流競爭激烈，用戶成長與漲價空間漸趨飽和
risks_en: The EPS miss reflects rising content or marketing costs; margins bear watching
At a 26x P/E, any growth slowdown can trigger a pullback
Intense streaming competition, with membership and pricing headroom maturing
